{{Quote|Zygerrians, you say? No stranger to them am I. Thrived on Outer Rim slave trade for centuries did the Zygerrian civilization. Moved from system to system, abducting primitive beings to enslave for profit&mdash;even into the systems of the Republic. When ordered to cease, resist did the Zygerrians. Crushed their empire of bondage did the Jedi. Ruined were these slavers, but refuse they did to change their ways. Into obscurity they fell...|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="TCW2" />}}
A '''conflict''' erupted between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] as part of a larger [[Outer Rim anti-slavery campaign]] waged by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Friends" /> after the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] did not comply to cease their [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] operations. The Jedi crushed the Zygerrians.

==Legacy==
{{Quote|Long before this war, you Jedi destroyed the great Zygerrian Slave Empire. I would kill you now, but Dooku would prefer you alive.|[[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
The Zygerrian [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] felt great resentment towards the Jedi for this act and took out his frustration on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in a [[Battle of Kiros|duel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Kidnapped" />
